in_marathi.name: Gajendar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajendar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gajendar is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the words 'Gaja' which means elephant and 'Dhar' which means throne. This name signifies one who is seated on an elephant throne, a symbol of power and strength.
